title: Challenge catalogue entry (IF-7, v0.1)
description: One VulnMart challenge in the catalogue. Data lives in challenges/catalog/cNN.yaml. Consumed by the platform (dashboards, API) and the lab (scoring, injector). v0.1 stubs carry tags, tier, placeholder milestones and hint slots; full briefs, write-ups and decoy locations are added in T-30. Rules a schema cannot express (tier must match difficulty, key must match the filename, exactly 11 entries, no real flag value) are checked by scripts/validate-catalog.mjs.

schema_version.description: Catalogue contract version this entry follows, 0.x until v1.0.0.

key.description: Stable challenge key c01..c11. Must match the filename.

status.description: stub = tags/tier/placeholders only (sprint zero); complete = full content (T-30 onward).

owasp.description: OWASP Top 10 edition tags. 2021 may be null (C11 has no 2021 category).

attack.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ids. At least one per challenge.

tier.description: Scoring tier derived from difficulty (D-32: 1-2 Easy, 3 Medium, 4-5 Hard). The validator enforces the mapping.

flag.description: Where and how the per-instance flag is placed. Provisional in a stub; confirmed in the challenge's own story.

delivery.description: How the player ultimately reads the flag. 'env' requires a written reason (FR-FLG-03).

reason.description: Why this delivery was chosen. Required when delivery is 'env' (FR-FLG-03); the validator enforces that.

start_state.description: Seeded starting point for the player (for example a seeded login). Placeholder in a stub.

milestones.description: M1 (found the weakness, 20%), M2 (working exploit evidence, 40%), M3 (flag captured, 100%). 'signal' is the concrete event/rule, null while a stub.

hints.description: Exactly three hint levels in order 1, 2, 3. 'text' is null while a stub (filled in T-30).

exploit_test.description: Path to the challenge's exploit test (pass on vulnerable, fail on fixed).

fixed_build.description: Path to the challenge's fixed-build reference.

allOf.description: Tier is derived from difficulty (D-32: 1-2 Easy, 3 Medium, 4-5 Hard).
